title: A restricted flat, locally finitely presented pre-relation has open quotient map
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a scheme S, a scheme U over S, an equivalence pre-relation j = (s, t) : R -> U x_S U whose two projections are surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, and a flat locally finitely presented g : U' -> U, the induced map of quotients U'/R' -> U/R is representable and an open immersion (source lines 1526-1541). The proof first verifies the restricted relation is again an equivalence relation, builds the invariant open W = t(s^{-1}(g(U'))) in U, and then describes an arbitrary morphism T -> U/R by an fppf covering with the transitional isomorphisms r_{jj'}, producing an open W_T in T that represents T x_{U/R} U'/R'; the two inclusions are checked on a further fppf covering.
